logline: 늑대 무리가 사람의 아기를 거두어 정글의 규칙 속에서 길러낸다.
destination: 달빛 내린 폐허 신전 — 아무도 함부로 들어가지 않는 곳
protagonist: 헝클어진 검은 머리에 허리끈만 두른 열 살 남짓 소년
setting: 인도의 깊은 정글, 늑대굴과 폐허가 된 옛 신전
anchor: a boy of about ten with tangled black hair, bare brown skin, a simple waist cord
palette: deep jungle green, warm amber, dry earth ochre, cool pale silver

mowgli.label: 모글리
mowgli.desc: a lean boy of about ten, tangled black hair, bare brown skin, a simple woven waist cord, bare feet

wolves.label: 늑대 무리
wolves.desc: a pack of grey Indian wolves, lean flanks, yellow eyes, ears pricked forward

panther.label: 검은 표범
panther.desc: a black panther with a sleek coat and amber eyes, muscles moving under the fur

bear.label: 곰
bear.desc: a big shaggy brown sloth bear with a pale muzzle and blunt claws

monkeys.label: 원숭이 떼
monkeys.desc: a swarm of grey langur monkeys with long tails and black faces

ruined_temple.label: 폐허 신전
ruined_temple.desc: a vine-swallowed stone temple, toppled pillars, cracked flagstones, roots through the walls

beats.visual: a small infant crawling into the mouth of a rocky wolf den at dusk, jungle behind
beats.motion: the infant crawls forward into the den, dust puffs under its hands, ferns shake

beats.visual: grey wolves closing in a ring around a small infant on the den floor, low light
beats.motion: the wolves draw in around the child, ears flick forward, dust settles

beats.visual: a bare-skinned boy running low beside grey wolves through tall jungle grass
beats.motion: they run forward through the grass toward the camera, stalks whip aside, dust streams

beats.visual: a black panther stretched along a thick branch looking down through jungle leaves
beats.motion: its tail sweeps along the branch, leaves shift, amber eyes track downward

beats.beat: 곰이 소년에게 나무 타기를 보여 준다.
beats.visual: a big shaggy bear hauling itself up a tree trunk while a boy watches from below
beats.motion: the bear climbs up the trunk, bark flakes fall, the boy tips his head back

beats.visual: grey langur monkeys carrying a struggling boy up through the jungle canopy
beats.motion: they haul him upward through the branches, leaves burst outward, tails whip

beats.visual: a boy set down among toppled pillars of a vine-swallowed stone temple in moonlight
beats.motion: he lands on the flagstones, vines swing overhead, dust lifts around his feet

beats.visual: empty moonlit flagstones between toppled temple pillars, vines hanging still
beats.motion: moonlight slides across the flagstones, vines sway, dust settles in the still air

withheld: 폐허에서 소년을 기다리던 것이 무엇인지와, 호랑이 시어 칸과의 마지막
